text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin seems to have even more fighting spirit than usual today...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Not really... It's just business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a hot-blooded idiot like Ticket.
I don't waste my energy getting fired up for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'll just win, no matter what. That's all.
